paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.78% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+1.63%) and Hang Seng weakest (-0.14%). Brent crude changed -5.28% to 109.7. Gold changed -0.34% to 4,024.7. Bitcoin changed -0.43% to 79,678.7969. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.986%, a relative move of -0.04%. Among the firms tracked, Santander (-3.66%) and Vale (-3.23%) moved the most.
